title: Apartment Design 119 m² in Kyiv, with 30 m² terrace
description: 119 m² apartment with 30 m² terrace in Kyiv: design project, custom furniture and turnkey renovation. DUMSKAYA DESIGN, Bratislava and Vienna.
h1: Luxury apartment interior design with a terrace in Kyiv, 119 m²

blocks.text: Luxury apartment interior design with a terrace in Kyiv, 119 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN developed an interior design project for a 119 m² apartment with a terrace in Kyiv, Ukraine. The interior concept is executed in a contemporary luxury style that combines elegant aesthetics, functionality, and a high level of everyday comfort.

The interior is based on minimalist lines, premium materials, and modern high-tech solutions. The space is finished in a calm, neutral color palette that creates an understated backdrop and highlights the architecture, materials, and individual interior details.

Particular attention was paid to the combination of natural wood, marble, and metal accents. The variety of textures creates a visually rich interior without excessive decor and supports the character of a contemporary premium space.

Lighting plays an important role in the concept. Different lighting scenarios help highlight materials and architectural elements, visually structure the space, and create a comfortable atmosphere at different times of day.

The terrace serves as an extension of the living space and complements the overall concept of the apartment. The project showcases the DUMSKAYA DESIGN approach to creating contemporary luxury interiors in which premium aesthetics go hand in hand with functionality and comfort.
